description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@10) performance across four different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) configurations as the number of queries used during inference increases from 1 to 10. The x-axis represents the “Number of queries used during inference (S)”, scaled linearly, ranging from 1 to 10, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents “MRR@10”, scaled linearly, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0. The plot displays four distinct lines: the black solid line labeled “DPR w/o query” remains constant at approximately 34.3 throughout the entire range; the red line with circular markers labeled “DPR w/ corpus expansion” starts at approximately 35.2, rises to a peak of 35.7 at S=2, then gradually declines to 35.9 at S=10; the green line with triangular markers labeled “DPR w/ document expansion” begins at approximately 34.9, fluctuates slightly around 34.9–35.0, and ends at approximately 34.9; and the blue line with diamond markers labeled “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” starts at approximately 34.9, peaks at approximately 35.0 at S=2, dips to a low of approximately 34.5 at S=6, and ends at approximately 34.4 at S=10.
